combos.name: Melt & Return
combos.desc: The rival's wall face slumps into lava; the lava runs back at the builder.

steps.hint: hold Smelter on the wall face

result.text: the wall slumps into lava and runs back

combos.name: Thunder Through Stone
combos.desc: Storm Bolt (T2) blasts through a Bulwark: E 36 beats grounding 30.

steps.hint: hold ATTACK to T2, release at the wall

result.text: the wall shatters, the bolt lands

combos.name: Split Return
combos.desc: Seize the incoming stone, split it, release aimed: three spikes fan back.

steps.hint: tap ATTACK while the technique is held

result.text: three spikes fan back at the thrower

combos.name: Swallow
combos.desc: Sink the stone into the ground just before impact (CP 22 >= 17).

steps.hint: GUARD flick down just before impact

result.text: the stone sinks into the ground

combos.name: Wave Back
combos.desc: Tidal Rush captures the incoming stone and carries it back.

steps.hint: ATTACK flick down as the stone arrives

result.text: the wave carries the stone back

combos.name: Molten Exchange
combos.desc: Magma-grip the stone, hold to molten, pour a lava wave at the thrower.

steps.hint: TECH on the stone, hold until molten, release aimed

result.text: the stone becomes a lava wave

combos.name: Turn the Wind
combos.desc: A perfect Wind Guard (27 >= 17) sends the stone back.

result.text: the stone returns to the thrower

combos.name: Live Wire
combos.desc: A wet target chains the Spark through the spray's puddles.

result.text: the arc chains through the wet ground

combos.name: Flash Freeze Lock
combos.desc: Wet, then frozen and rooted: the heave cannot be evaded.

result.text: the rooted target takes the heave

combos.name: Glass Shrapnel
combos.desc: A bolt turns the Dune Wall to glass; a Sound Lance shatters it into shards.

result.text: the glass wall shatters into shards

combos.name: Fire Tornado
combos.desc: A Fireball fed into a tornado makes a fire tornado you steer.

result.text: the tornado ignites

combos.name: Sandstorm
combos.desc: A tornado through a grit cloud walks a sandstorm at the rival.

result.text: a blinding sandstorm walks forward

combos.name: Lightning Rod Bait
combos.desc: An embedded lance relays the bolt through the rival's wall.

result.text: the bolt relays through the lance

combos.name: Recall Pincer
combos.desc: Three discs past the rival fly back through them.

result.text: the discs come back through the rival

combos.name: Obsidian Fort
combos.desc: Water on your own Magma Curtain sets the face to obsidian: CP 28 to 38.

result.text: the face sets to obsidian

combos.name: Mud Bog
combos.desc: Quicksand plus spray makes mud: a longer, stronger slow.

result.text: the bog turns to mud

combos.name: No Air, No Fire
combos.desc: The Null Bubble snuffs the rival's flames at the shell (x2).

steps.hint: Null Bubble as the flames arrive

result.text: the flames die at the shell

combos.name: Echo Bank Shot
combos.desc: A Sound Lance off a pillar reflects into the rival behind cover.

result.text: the pulse reflects into the rival

combos.name: Geyser Launcher
combos.desc: Geyser launch, wind juggle, ground finisher on landing.

result.text: an air juggle into a ground finisher

combos.name: Ember Wade
combos.desc: Advance inside your own lava wave while the rival must evade it.

result.text: you wade behind the wave

combos.name: Implosion Ignition
combos.desc: Burst at the centre of a collapsing Vacuum Well: combustion x1.5 in the inrush.

steps.hint: Vacuum Well pulls the rival, release

result.text: the burst is amplified in the inrush

combos.name: Ice Bridge
combos.desc: Skate across the pool; frozen water will not conduct the rival's bolt.

result.text: you skate across the pool

combos.name: Quench & Seize
combos.desc: Quench the lava wave to hot rock, then catch it without burns.

steps.hint: Magma Hold on the hot rock

result.text: you hold the hot rock

combos.name: Vine Slingshot
combos.desc: Vinegrip a far stone, wrap it, release: it roots the rival on hit.

steps.hint: tap ATTACK while the technique is held

result.text: the wrapped stone roots the rival

combos.name: Static Return
combos.desc: The Static Ward absorbs the bolt; Static Burst sends it back as a stun cone.

steps.hint: Static Ward as the bolt arrives

result.text: the bolt returns as a stun cone

combos.name: Frost Shatter
combos.desc: Chill, frozen crust, then a Clap shatters it: bonus damage and stagger.

result.text: the crust shatters

combos.name: Reverse Tide
combos.desc: Magma Hold on the rival's lava wave (contest won), release it back.

result.text: the wave turns back

combos.name: Catch & Unleash
combos.desc: The Vortex Wall captures the volley; Unleash flies every captured projectile back.

steps.hint: Vortex Wall as the volley arrives

result.text: every captured projectile flies back
